relevance_note: Case report of one boy with GAMT deficiency carrying a homozygous GAMT variant: "we present a case of a child diagnosed with GAMT deficiency".
method_note: Hand extraction, JSON assembled with a short Python script. In scope: the proband ('patient', rule 5), his affected sister (not genetically tested; ID, epileptic encephalopathy, disturbed EEGs, deceased), the mother (tested heterozygous) and the foetus/younger sibling (tested heterozygous by CVS; sex not stated, labelled 'sibling of patient'). The father is mentioned only as one of the 'healthy consanguineous parents' (not tested, not affected) and gets no row. 'Healthy' parents was not used to exclude any checklist item. Inheritance 'inherited maternal' for the proband (homozygous) and the foetus (heterozygous) follows the v4 rule (named parent stated to carry the same variant); the father was not tested, so the foetus's allele could in principle be paternal. Variant type 'splice' rests on the authors' prediction that the variant disturbs the donor splice site; no functional assay was done (functional_evidence left not reported). Pathogenicity VUS (class 3) and the authors' prediction of causality were given for the proband's variant only; relatives' rows leave classification fields not reported (D-29). Age at diagnosis not stated: a gene panel at age 9 was negative and WES was done 'thereafter'. Age at last evaluation not stated (only '1.7 years of follow-up'). Vital status of the proband not explicitly stated. Possible internal tension: 'His motor development was normal but he walked at 1.8 years' (both recorded). Also 'He was the first child' while an affected sister existed (her birth order not stated). Brain MRI described as normal including appearance and intensity of brain parenchyma and ventricular system; used to exclude the three MRI checklist items. 'The rest of the neurological evaluation was normal' is a whole-exam statement and was not used to exclude specific items. Athetoid movements were not counted as 'chorea, choreoathetosis or ballismus' (left not reported); speech delay counted as 'absent or limited speech' observed. The sister's 'complications' after MRS were not recorded as a feature (unspecified). Supplementary file is the negative gene-panel gene list; no patient data in it.

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Clinical phenotype and family history plus whole-exome sequencing finding a homozygous GAMT variant (classified VUS); a neurological gene panel was negative; MRS refused by the mother; enzymatic studies not performed
span: Whole-exome sequencing was conducted and identified a novel homozygous GAMT variant (NM_138924.2:c.391+5G>C).

we found that our patient had many typical clinical phenotypes of CCDS2 with a family history of these presentations. In addition, no other mutation was identified to be related to his disease. Thus, we predicted that the novel GAMT variant c.391+5G>C should be responsible for CCDS2.
